The tetragonal phase Tb4Tc4 (Tb2Tc2) crystallizes in space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Tc centers with ten geometric neighbors (2 Tc, 8 Tb) and Tb centers with twelve neighbors (8 Tc, 4 Tb), the latter forming a close-packed-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Tc-centered 10-vertex and Tb-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge sharing between Tb-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
